doctrine.global_control_plane: die-control Windows VPS; one global Mission Control logical singleton
doctrine.h01_scope: die-h01 Linux Factory Asset execution plane
doctrine.legacy_live: /srv/die is LEGACY LIVE / ROLLBACK and must never be reset/pulled in place to catch origin/main
doctrine.production_first: Build -> Ship -> CUAN; 43,005 eligible nouns become standalone VECTOR_OBJECT/SINGLE assets before set/demand expansion
doctrine.browser_topology: 20 UDD x 5 persistent profiles; max 1 active profile and 1 committed tab/job per UDD; close Brave after durable job result
doctrine.svg_lineage: provider-original immutable -> canonical SVG master -> deterministic derivatives -> read-back QA
doctrine.demand: non-blocking later prioritization/family intelligence, never prerequisite for standalone noun production

execution_rules: one fresh isolated engineering worktree per task/session
no irreversible legacy cutover before bounded acceptance
no marketplace publication without Founder authorization
Mission Control is durable task truth; browser chat text alone cannot mark DONE

canonical_profile_naming.active_invariant: max 1 active profile + 1 committed tab/job per UDD
canonical_profile_naming.lifecycle: IDLE -> round-robin eligible sibling -> spawn one Brave/profile -> one provider/job -> durable result -> close Brave -> IDLE

tasks.title: Audit live H01 Linux disk, runtime, services, browser ownership and Git hygiene
tasks.acceptance: Record filesystem capacity, runtime services, active browser paths, Git/worktree state and protected production data without mutating active production state.

tasks.title: Consolidate historical engineering worktrees and regenerable caches
tasks.acceptance: Leave /srv/die plus one current isolated session worktree; preserve unique dirty source evidence; remove stale worktree/clone copies and regenerable caches.

tasks.title: Implement enforced ephemeral worktree lifecycle
tasks.acceptance: Provide helper/policy that creates one /home/kopiko/die-sessions/<task> worktree from current origin/main, refuses /srv/die mutation, and removes closed worktrees after closure.

tasks.title: Classify live /srv/die dirty state and create immutable migration snapshot
tasks.acceptance: Capture source diff, deployed-unit references and runtime-only files without reset/stash/clean; freeze legacy live source for rollback before V2 cutover.

tasks.title: Classify H01 data retention and eliminate only proven disposable duplicates
tasks.acceptance: For Atlas DBs/raw dumps, migration backups, production state, artifacts, logs and /opt staging classify ACTIVE, ROLLBACK, ARCHIVE, REGENERABLE or DISPOSABLE; delete only verified DISPOSABLE data.

tasks.title: Freeze one global Mission Control on separate Windows die-control failure domain
tasks.acceptance: Mission Control remains one global singleton; die-h01 is an execution plane and does not own a second business scheduler.

tasks.title: Inventory and accept target die-control Windows VPS
tasks.acceptance: Verify Mission Control, Universal MCP, State Manager bridge, principal registry, durable state, backup/recovery and network ingress before cutover.

tasks.title: Define narrow H01 Runtime Gateway contract
tasks.acceptance: Authenticated durable Work Card dispatch/checkpoint/result across VPS boundary; browser/CDP/filesystem stay H01-local and no per-click WAN orchestration is allowed.

tasks.title: Rebind H03 supervision to the global Mission Control endpoint
tasks.acceptance: H03 accepted supervision boundary continues logically while endpoint/host binding moves to the global Windows control plane; no H03-owned Mission Control instance.

tasks.title: Implement deterministic Canonical Feeder
tasks.acceptance: When queue policy requires work, read accepted graph/policy and enqueue only dependency-, budget- and lease-eligible Work Cards; no LLM or autonomous scope expansion.

tasks.title: Implement recovery-only Supervisor boundary
tasks.acceptance: Observe MC/H01 services/browser owners/factories and execute only allowlisted bounded L0/L1 recovery; no business-work generation or hidden scheduler.

tasks.title: Prove single business scheduler and anti-duplicate dispatch
tasks.acceptance: Mission Control is the only business scheduler; legacy timers/agents cannot create competing work; same durable job cannot be committed twice.

tasks.title: Install Brave alongside legacy Chrome without cutover
tasks.acceptance: Brave Stable is installed and observable while existing Chrome production owners remain untouched and rollback-capable.

tasks.title: Lock browser topology: 20 UDD x 5 persistent profiles = 100 profiles
tasks.acceptance: Map s01->p001..p005 through s20->p096..p100. Exactly one active profile and one committed tab/job per UDD; sibling profiles may never overlap.

tasks.title: Accept one master Brave profile baseline under real Web-AI use
tasks.acceptance: Prove one profile first: persistence, restart, loopback CDP, download/output acquisition, provider completion behavior and RAM/renderer/disk telemetry. Founder provides manual authentication.

tasks.title: Implement safe 20-UDD / 100-profile provisioner
tasks.acceptance: Clone browser configuration/layout only, not cookies/tokens/session secrets; create 20 UDDs with five mapped profile identities each.

tasks.title: Implement Brave storage and janitor capacity gate
tasks.acceptance: Measure populated-profile growth; clean only regenerable cache while UDD is closed; protect authentication/session stores; added storage may satisfy capacity without changing topology.

tasks.title: Implement one-owner-per-UDD Brave runtime with loopback CDP
tasks.acceptance: Each UDD starts exactly one selected sibling profile, exactly one committed provider tab/job, loopback CDP only, and closes Brave after durable success/failure receipt.

tasks.title: Implement per-UDD round-robin profile/provider lease scheduler
tasks.acceptance: Select eligible sibling profiles fairly inside each UDD; enforce UDD mutex, provider readiness/cooldown, exactly-once dispatch and no same-UDD sibling overlap.

tasks.title: Run staged multi-UDD concurrency acceptance
tasks.acceptance: Measure 1->2->4->8->10 active UDD owners for RAM, renderer/process count, disk growth, provider stability and recovery; scale above 10 only from evidence, never beyond 20 UDD owners.

tasks.title: Lock supply-first standalone SVG MVP
tasks.acceptance: Use exactly the 43,005 eligible Object Atlas nouns with media=VECTOR, mode=VECTOR_OBJECT, form=SINGLE, preset=CLEAN_STOCK_VECTOR_V1. Demand/set/Product Expression expansion is not a blocker.

tasks.title: Export deterministic production queue from the 43,005 eligible Object Atlas nouns
tasks.acceptance: Create stable IDs/order and basic rights/feasibility gates without mutating Atlas source truth; queue creation is idempotent.

tasks.title: Upgrade Blueprint -> Master Instruction -> Prompt Composer v2
tasks.acceptance: Compile sophisticated commercial/vector constraints into bounded provider prompts while Blueprint remains provider-independent WHAT and prompt logic remains HOW.

tasks.title: Upgrade SVG safety/editability/geometry engine to production subset
tasks.acceptance: Support safe shapes and curve commands demonstrated by real Claude SVG samples while forbidding script/external refs/embedded raster and enforcing complexity/render bounds.

tasks.title: Generalize provider-independent native-SVG request/receipt contract
tasks.acceptance: web-ai-adapter is default ingress and native MCP optional; preserve blueprint/prompt hashes, provider result, exactly-once authority and no raster-trace success claims.

tasks.title: Implement deterministic Vector Postproduction v1
tasks.acceptance: Preserve immutable provider-original lineage; produce canonical SVG then optimized SVG, true vector PDF, validated EPS, PNG alpha, WebP and JPG; conditional TIFF/SVGZ/DXF; never rasterize through PNG for vector outputs.

tasks.title: Record Claude Sonnet 4.6 native-SVG capability proof
tasks.acceptance: Founder-downloaded native SVG samples exist and visual QC passed; capability proof is DONE but complete stock technical acceptance remains downstream.

tasks.title: Add provider-by-provider native-SVG canaries after Claude baseline
tasks.acceptance: Canary additional eligible Web-AI providers one by one; record NATIVE_SVG, TEXT_SVG, UNSUPPORTED or DEFERRED honestly; no provider is promoted from model capability alone.

tasks.title: Prove first 100 standalone SVG nouns before larger rollout
tasks.acceptance: Generate 100 unique semantic masters from eligible nouns with provider-original lineage, canonical master, read-back QA, derivatives, metadata/rights and honest resource telemetry; no duplicate semantic count.

tasks.title: Accept Founder-QC-ready standalone SVG package and real upload path
tasks.acceptance: Package preserves semantic-master/derivative/package counters and produces at least one real Founder-uploaded stock acceptance before scale-out.

tasks.title: Prove one complete V2 SVG production cycle from global Mission Control
tasks.acceptance: Global MC to H01 Work Card to Brave/provider to SVG master to derivatives to QA/metadata/rights to package to durable completion is observable end-to-end without SSH spelunking.

tasks.title: Run bounded shadow coexistence with legacy H01 organism
tasks.acceptance: V2 and legacy paths coexist without duplicate business work; rollback remains available and receipts demonstrate equivalent required capabilities.

tasks.title: Cut business scheduling to global Mission Control only
tasks.acceptance: Disable legacy business schedulers/timers only after accepted V2 coexistence; Supervisor remains health-only and no second work creator exists.

tasks.title: Retire Hermes and OpenCode from H01 production critical path
tasks.acceptance: Stop/disable/remove production dependency only after no accepted V2 capability depends on them; keep OpenCode solely in engineering lane if still useful.

tasks.title: Retire legacy Chrome cluster identities and stale runtime packages
tasks.acceptance: After Brave equivalence and session migration/login completion, drain legacy cluster-a/b owners and compatibility names; remove only proven unused runtime packages/state under retention policy.

tasks.title: Scale beyond eight active owners only from measured throughput economics
tasks.acceptance: Use queue wait, service time, RAM/storage, provider health, failure rate and unit economics to decide more active owners or additional H01 nodes; 100 configured profiles never implies 100 concurrent browsers.

tasks.title: Implement Brave cache janitor with auth-state protection
tasks.acceptance: Clean only regenerable caches while the UDD is closed; protect Cookies/Local Storage/IndexedDB/session/preference stores; threshold and receipt every cleanup.

tasks.title: Run staged multi-UDD concurrency acceptance
tasks.acceptance: Measure 1->2->4->8->10 active UDD owners for renderer/process count, RAM, disk growth, provider stability and recovery; scale above 10 only from evidence up to the 20-UDD hard ceiling.

tasks.title: Run 10-noun standalone SVG pilot
tasks.acceptance: 10 unique semantic masters pass idempotency, resource telemetry, QA, metadata and packaging.

tasks.title: Run 100-noun standalone SVG acceptance
tasks.acceptance: 100 unique semantic masters with failure taxonomy, provider/profile telemetry and no duplicate semantic count.

tasks.title: Run 1,000-noun production-scale batch
tasks.acceptance: Demonstrate sustained multi-UDD throughput, bounded retries, storage janitor and observable Mission Control standing.

tasks.title: Open governed rollout across the 43,005 eligible noun queue
tasks.acceptance: Run supply-first production under throughput/storage/rights/submission gates; preserve semantic master vs derivative vs package counters.

tasks.title: Define semantic Family v1 schema and five family classes
tasks.acceptance: TAXONOMIC/FUNCTIONAL/CONTEXTUAL/VARIANT/SYSTEM with family_id, members, source and rights_class; distinguish semantic family, design set, derivative bundle and listing package.

tasks.title: Implement deterministic taxonomy-first family mapper over Object Atlas
tasks.acceptance: Create candidate families without changing standalone noun identity; preserve evidence and duplicates/alias controls.

tasks.title: Implement brand/trademark rights gate for family/set candidates
tasks.acceptance: Brand-restricted systems may be discovered but cannot route silently to normal stock production.

tasks.title: Implement Design Set composer v1
tasks.acceptance: Build coherent set blueprints only after standalone factory is alive; set members are semantic members while format bundles remain derivatives.

tasks.title: Define non-blocking Demand Signal Engine contract
tasks.acceptance: External signals rank remaining nouns and help discover buyer/use-case/families; they never determine Object Atlas validity and never block standalone production.

tasks.title: Add bounded official/ToS-safe market signal connectors
tasks.acceptance: Prefer supported structured sources and accepted observation paths; no fragile autocomplete scraping as core dependency.

tasks.title: Join Human Atlas demand context without Cartesian explosion
tasks.acceptance: Bounded retrieval of buyer/activity/problem/industry/commercial-intent context; supply-first production remains independent.

tasks.title: Implement evidence-scored noun/family prioritization
tasks.acceptance: Re-rank remaining production queue and family hypotheses from demand/competition/confidence evidence without invalidating already-produced masters.

tasks.title: Define ChatGPT Architect browser-worker session contract
tasks.acceptance: Each worker gets one Mission Control task, principal/lease, one isolated worktree, exact constraints and machine-readable final marker/result; no chat-memory-only completion.

tasks.title: Implement browser/CDP Architect worker dispatcher
tasks.acceptance: Lease a dedicated engineering UDD/profile, open one ChatGPT Architect session, inject Mission Control bootstrap, observe durable result/checkpoint, then close browser.

tasks.title: Implement progress-aware worker completion detector and result ingestion
tasks.acceptance: No premature cuts; use durable Mission Control state/result marker, recover failed/stalled sessions and never infer DONE solely from rendered chat text.

tasks.title: Enforce per-worker Git/worktree/lease isolation
tasks.acceptance: Parallel Architect workers cannot share mutable worktrees or conflicting repo-write lease; dependency and merge gates stay canonical.

tasks.title: Run two-worker parallel Architect canary
tasks.acceptance: Two independent dependency-safe tasks execute in separate browser workers, checkpoint durably, complete and return auditable artifacts without collision.

tasks.title: Scale engineering workers only by dependency-ready graph width
tasks.acceptance: Dispatcher schedules parallel tasks only when dependencies/resources/leases allow; Mission Control remains sole durable task truth.

tasks.title: Evaluate NNk/day expansion from measured economics and concurrency
tasks.acceptance: Scale storage/CPU/UDD concurrency/nodes only when acceptance, cost, provider limits, janitor and marketplace throughput support it.
